title: The Mn3O4/biochar composite prepared from straw biochar and divalent manganese: investigation of synthetic conditions and malachite green degradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24872-24879
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03281D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jianpo Zhang, Tianqi Wang, He Gao, Yuan Gao, Li Jin
In this study, the goal was to recycle and reuse manganese in wastewater by use of a cheap material biochar, ammonia, and hydrogen peroxide to produce a Mn3O4/biochar composite, which could be used for the degradation of dye in wastewater.
